dedupe_keys.name: disponibilite a 30 jours de places max jeune et max senior ouvertes a la reservation

description: Disponibilité à 30 jours de places MAX JEUNE et MAX SENIOR ouvertes à la réservation is a dataset listed in SNCF Open Data, an open data portal of a railway operator, published or maintained by SNCF. Ce jeu de données présente la liste des trains MAX JEUNE (abonnement illimité pour les 16-27 ans sur TGV INOUI et INTERCITÉS à réservation obligatoire) et MAX SENIOR (abonnement illimité pour les 60 ans et plus sur TGV INOUI et INTERCITÉS à réservation obligatoire). Coverage: France. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Tarifs voyageurs. Its keywords are tgvmax, max jeune, max senior. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODbL) (https://data.sncf.com/pages/cgu/A1#A1). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sncf-open-data-portal.
